### 1. Layout Name

What is the filename for your layout? (e.g., `daily_planner.json`, `storyboard_4_panel.json`)

### 2. Description

Please provide a one-sentence description for the `README.md` file. (e.g., "A daily planner with sections for schedule, tasks, and notes.")

### 3. Category

Which category from `examples/json_layouts/README.md` does this best fit into?
(e.g., Note Taking, Planning & Productivity, Creative & Design, Technical & Engineering, Music, Gaming & RPG, Learning & Study, Specialized)

### 4. JSON Layout Code

Paste the full contents of your `.json` file in the code block below.

```json
{
  "paste_your": "json_layout_here"
}

### 5. (Optional) Screenshot
If you've already generated the template, please attach a screenshot of the final PNG!
